description: Structured status of the case-study verifications. Every identifier and statement is taken from docs/CASE_STUDIES.md (sections cited) or from the persisted outputs of agents 10a/10d/10e. 'documented_status' is the status written in the case-study record; 'criteria' applies the fixed checklist below. Nothing here is new evidence.

criteria_definitions.ids_verified: identifiers checked against ClinicalTrials.gov / PubMed responses
criteria_definitions.trial_roles_checked: the role of each linking trial (test, comparator, co-medication, procedural) was inspected
criteria_definitions.evidence_both_sides: supporting AND null/opposing evidence searched and recorded with sources (not_applicable when the verdict is an artefact rejection)
criteria_definitions.temporal_stated: pre/post-cutoff position of the evidence stated
criteria_definitions.overlap_checked: shared trials / overlapping publications assessed (doc or agent 10e)
criteria_definitions.safety_noted: safety evidence or the safety dimension's limitation recorded
